If the coordinator fails, backup copies (replicas) elect a new leader. Even after the election finishes, reading data may still return outdated information.

The payment system avoids duplicate billing (it is idempotent) only if requests use the original idempotency key. If a request times out, you cannot tell if the first charge went through. Retrying with a new key is not covered by this safeguard and can cause a second charge.

Throttling incoming traffic (backpressure) limits the rate of new requests while the waiting line clears; it does not cancel requests the system has already accepted.
